Google Compute Engine Machine Type n2-standard-8

General-purpose Google Compute Engine machine type n2-standard-8 with 8 vCPU and 32 GB memory. GCE machine type n2-standard-8 is certified for SAP applications on Google Cloud Platform. Available in 40 Google Cloud regions.
